verdict.rationale: Microsoft's privacy FAQ documents a user-facing opt-out from using conversation activity for model training at any time, so the product itself provides the capability. A community note says this opt-out applies only to the standalone Copilot chat app and website, not to Copilot integrated into Office 365, which limits its scope. missing for 10: documentation that the opt-out covers data beyond conversation activity (e.g., connected-service data, files in Word/Office Copilot), first-party details on how and where to set it, independent hands-on confirmation that it works

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: You can opt out of use of your conversation activity for model training at any time.
To be clear this is only for the standalone Copilot chat or app and website; not for the 'Copilot' services integrated into Office 365 etc.
